name: Redefined Zero Video Gallery
author: Reza Hossain Farukh

sections.description:
Redefined Zero Video Gallery (Orvian Soft) adds a videos custom post type, saved gallery shortcodes, single video pages, and responsive grid layouts with modal or direct link playback.

Here are the Demos:

View live Video Gallery demos

Support:

Get support at Orvian Soft

Redefined Zero Video Gallery registers:

  • Video Gallery admin menu — custom post type rzvg_video
  • Video URL field on each item — easily embed YouTube or Vimeo videos (with title, editor, excerpt, and featured image)
  • Video Categories taxonomy to organize your videos into categories
  • Single template — dedicated single video page template (templates/single-rzvg_video.php)
  • All galleries & Add gallery — create saved galleries with custom Data and Styles settings
  • Default Gallery Settings — site-wide Data and Styles defaults for your galleries
  • Shortcode [rzvg_video_gallery id="N"] — embed video galleries anywhere with responsive grid, modal popup, or link layouts (omit id for gallery 1)

Permalinks: after activation visit Settings → Permalinks and click Save once if URLs 404.

Plans

The plugin is free to install and fully functional. Optional paid plans and add-ons provide additional advanced options and priority support.

Free

  • Unlimited videos, categories, and saved galleries
  • [rzvg_video_gallery] shortcode and single video pages
  • Default Gallery Settings — configure grid batch size, columns per row (desktop, tablet, mobile), pagination, load more, titles, and click behavior
  • Per-gallery Data Settings and Styles customization
  • Use post featured image as video cover

Professional

  • Advanced styling presets, additional card designs, and priority technical support.

Ultimate

  • Advanced customization options, premium design presets, and priority technical support.

Upgrade inside the plugin via the Freemius account screen, or visit Orvian Soft.

External services

This plugin can load videos and thumbnails from third-party video platforms, and uses Freemius for optional paid plans, licensing, and updates. Below is what connects from your WordPress site, what is sent, and when.

Video embeds (visitor’s browser)

When a gallery or single video page displays a video, the visitor’s browser may load embed players and assets from the host you chose for that video (YouTube, Vimeo, Youku, Dailymotion, Bilibili, or a self-hosted file from your site). The plugin does not upload your WordPress content to those hosts; it outputs embed markup or links using the URL you saved on each video.

  • YouTube — Used for playback and optional grid thumbnails (img.youtube.com). oEmbed/embed data is requested through WordPress when resolving a YouTube URL. Sent: the video URL (and standard HTTP request metadata). When: saving or displaying a YouTube video, or when a thumbnail is built from oEmbed.
    Terms: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms — Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  • Vimeo — Used for playback and optional poster images via WordPress oEmbed. Sent: the video URL. When: displaying a Vimeo video or resolving its thumbnail.
    Terms: https://vimeo.com/terms — Privacy: https://vimeo.com/privacy

  • Dailymotion — Used for playback (embed iframe) and grid posters (dailymotion.com thumbnail URLs). Sent: the video URL or ID derived from it. When: displaying a Dailymotion video or its cover image.
    Terms: https://legal.dailymotion.com/en/terms-of-use/ — Privacy: https://legal.dailymotion.com/en/privacy-policy/

  • Youku — Used for playback (player.youku.com embed). Sent: the video URL or ID in embed parameters. When: a visitor views a Youku video on your site.
    Terms: https://www.youku.com/pub/service/home — Privacy: https://ac.youku.com/wow/ykpage/act/flsm

  • Bilibili — Used for playback (player.bilibili.com embed). Sent: video reference (BV ID or av ID) in embed parameters. When: a visitor views a Bilibili video on your site.
    Terms: https://www.bilibili.com/protocal/licence.html — Privacy: https://www.bilibili.com/blackboard/privacy-pc.html

Server-side requests (WordPress site → external APIs)

These calls are made from your server to fetch metadata or poster images. Results are cached in WordPress transients or post meta where possible.

  • Bilibili public API (https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/view) — Used to obtain the official cover image URL for a Bilibili video when you save or display a Bilibili item. Sent: the video identifier (bvid or aid parsed from the URL you entered). When: syncing or showing a Bilibili poster, or when the poster cache is empty.
    Terms: https://www.bilibili.com/protocal/licence.html — Privacy: https://www.bilibili.com/blackboard/privacy-pc.html

  • Bilibili CDN (image host returned by the API, e.g. hdslb.com) — Used to download the poster image bytes so they can be shown in the grid (some CDNs block direct browser hotlinking). Sent: the poster image URL and a Referer: https://www.bilibili.com/ header. When: generating or refreshing a Bilibili cover, including the optional admin-ajax.php?action=rzvg_bilibili_poster image proxy for front-end visitors.
    Terms: https://www.bilibili.com/protocal/licence.html — Privacy: https://www.bilibili.com/blackboard/privacy-pc.html

  • Youku UPS API (https://ups.youku.com/ups/get.json) — Used to resolve the official poster URL for a Youku video ID. Sent: the Youku video ID and a client token (utid) obtained from https://log.mmstat.com/eg.js, plus a Referer: https://v.youku.com/ header. When: building or refreshing a Youku grid thumbnail (cached per video ID).
    Terms: https://www.youku.com/pub/service/home — Privacy: https://ac.youku.com/wow/ykpage/act/flsm

  • log.mmstat.com (Youku / Alibaba Token Service) (https://log.mmstat.com/eg.js) — Used to obtain an anonymous client token (utid) required for authenticating server requests to the Youku UPS poster API. Sent: standard HTTP request headers to retrieve the token. When: resolving or refreshing a Youku video poster image.
    Terms: https://www.youku.com/pub/service/home — Privacy: https://ac.youku.com/wow/ykpage/act/flsm

  • WordPress oEmbed — For supported URLs, WordPress may contact the provider’s oEmbed endpoint to fetch embed HTML and thumbnail URLs (notably Vimeo; other hosts may apply). Sent: the video URL you stored on the video post. When: rendering embeds or resolving oEmbed thumbnails.

No server-side API call is required for self-hosted videos (Media Library or direct MP4 URL); those files are served from your own site.

Freemius (optional licensing & updates)

The plugin includes the Freemius SDK for free/pro/ultimate plan activation, plugin updates, and checkout flows. If you opt in or purchase a plan, Freemius may process account, license, and site information according to its policies. Sent: depends on your actions in the Freemius opt-in, activation, or checkout UI (e.g. email, site URL, license key). When: installing/updating the plugin, activating a license, or opening Freemius admin screens—not on ordinary public gallery page views unless you use those features.

Service: Freemius — Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/ — Privacy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

Orvian Soft (optional links only)

Upgrade and support links in the admin may point to https://orviansoft.com/. Those pages open only when you click them; the plugin does not automatically transmit site data to Orvian Soft for gallery playback.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the rzvg-video-gallery folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate Redefined Zero Video Gallery under Plugins.
  3. Visit Settings → Permalinks and click Save once (rewrites for video URLs).
  4. Add items under Video Gallery → Add New, paste a YouTube or Vimeo URL in the video URL field, set title/image/excerpt as needed.
  5. Create a gallery under Video Gallery → All galleries, then embed [rzvg_video_gallery id="N"] on a page.
  6. Create a gallery under Video Gallery → All galleries, configure data and styles as desired, then embed [rzvg_video_gallery id="N"] on a page.
sections.faq:
What is included in the free version?

Unlimited videos, categories, galleries, shortcodes, single video pages, responsive column settings, pagination, load more, and gallery styling controls.

What do paid plans add?

Paid plans add advanced styling options, priority support, and premium design presets.

How do I get support?

Get support at Orvian Soft

Open our support page and use the form to contact us.
